generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The selected bidder should produce MDP Copy while submitting the Bill from the Competitive Authority, authorized by the Mines and Geology Department of Karnataka. 5 times of royalty amount 40% of extra amount of royalty amount and 10% of royalty amount deducted towards of Mines Department in the absence MDP. (As per Govt order Ltr No. M&GD/DCB/2023-24 Dt: 07.11.2023)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details

GST: The amount put to tender is excluding GST. The bidder should quote for the amount put to tender. However GST will be paid separately as per the applicable laws subject to the conditions mentioned in the Govt. circular No. FD 417 EXP-12/2024 dated 09-08-2024. G.S.T will be paid at 18% or applicable rates at the time of payment of RA Bills, subject to verification. -
Each of the documents uploaded to the kpp-portal should be self attested by the contractor or an authorized representative in case of firm/company
The contractor should neither make any alteration in the conditions of contract or not stipulate any conditions of his own
Evaluation will be done based on the information provided by the contractor as per the document uploaded through kpp portal the correctness of the uploaded document will be verified if necessary
The bidders shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of kpp portal on or before the last date of bid submission (Through Electronic Media)

Any bidders who is otherwise technically qualified withdraws from the bidding process at any stage before a final decisions taken on the tender, the EMD of such bidder shall be forfeited, the name of such bidder shall be removed from the category list of contractors at least for a minimum period of one year in KNNL, besides making such bidders liable for black listing.

Any of the bidder who withdraws from the bidding process after completion of tender submission date at any stage before a final decision taken on the tender, the EMD of such bidder shall be forfeited and the name of such bidder shall be barred from participation in any of the tenders invited by KNNL thereafter.
The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders
The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of kpp portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Karnataka Neeravari Nigam Ltd., Reserves the right to verify the correctness of the statements and documents furnished and inspect the jobs executed by the agency/firm, if found necessary
The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Document .(SBD)
All relevant documents as per the KNNL need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in kpp portal.
Bidders should not be under any declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Scanned Signature of the Bidder / Authorized Representative in case of firm / company to be attached while uploading bid documents along with valid power of attorney
The officer competent to accept the tenders shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason and whatsoever.
The contractor should adhere to the accepted execution plan submitted by his under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work & also Land acquisition problems if any
Bidder should having Annual Turnover of more than Rs.100.00 crores shall submit GST E-Invoice, while claiming the Bills under the above work.
Typo-graphical errors, if any, will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor.
EMD of the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of the tenders by the competent authority (Clause 18 of the formal tender notice adopted version of KPWD form-66).
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address & mail address in declaration forms
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled.
The contractors/Firm shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature.
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected.
Corrigendum will be published in the KPP Portal / News paper for all modifications / corrections, if any
Further corrigendum/ modifications/ corrections/ addendum if any can be had from https://www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in.
Further details and information about electronic tendering can be had from http://www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in OR undersigned in all working days during Office hours on telephone No: 8660573513.
